title: Flat Allowance Carried by a Line Put Right
content:
Where a line under one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders is put right, the flat allowance its benefit category carries is settled by what the line put right is.

## The rule

1. Where the line put right is a hearing aid, the allowance is the allowance for a hearing aid for one ear the rider held carries.
2. Where the line put right is a set of eyeglass frames, the allowance is the frame allowance the rider held carries.
3. Where the line put right is a pair of spectacle lenses, the allowance is the lens allowance the rider held carries.
4. Where the line put right is contact lenses worn instead of spectacles, the allowance is the contact lens allowance the rider held carries.
5. Otherwise the allowance is nothing, the benefit category carrying no flat allowance.

## The allowances each rider carries

| Rider | Hearing aid, one ear (USD) | Eyeglass frames (USD) | Spectacle lenses (USD) | Contact lenses (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0.00 | 175.00 | 150.00 | 160.00 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 1250.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 1500.00 | 250.00 | 200.00 | 220.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Four kinds of line carry a flat allowance and no others.** A hearing aid, a set of eyeglass frames, a pair of spectacle lenses, and contact lenses worn instead of spectacles.

**A dental line put right carries no flat allowance.** Preventive, basic restorative and major restorative dental care, root canal treatment, gum treatment, oral surgery, dentures and implants all fall under the fifth case, and so do a routine eye examination and a hearing examination.

**The allowance is the rider's own.** Two riders carry a hearing aid allowance for one ear — 1250.00 USD on the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider and 1500.00 USD on the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider — and two carry the three vision allowances.
